meta.name: set-a-small
meta.description: Small single-cluster demo (T307 polished): 1 cluster / 3 nodes / 24 NPUs (1 degraded) / 12 mixed-status workloads incl. 3 Qwen-8B PD variants (inter-node + intra-node affinity + cross-NUMA non-affinity, spec D6). Events 0-180s narrate the 5-page demo; 180-250s narrate the D6 affinity-vs-non-affinity perf comparison.
